About Us

People strategy that works in practice.

293consulting is a people and HR consulting company that helps organisations build stronger teams, clearer ways of working and workplaces where people can perform at their best. We work with leaders who want their people practices to support the direction and growth of their business.

Our support covers people operations, workplace culture, talent development and workforce insight. Whether an organisation is putting essential HR foundations in place or strengthening an established function, we bring structure to priorities and focus to the work that matters most.

We begin by understanding the organisation, its people and the challenges in front of it. From there, we develop practical recommendations that fit the team’s goals, resources and day-to-day reality—giving leaders clear next steps and helping their people carry positive change forward.
